chapter.verse: Topa aw, nangmah in khang tawntunga kote omna mun na hi hi.
Mual liante leitang leh leitung na bawl mapek, a tawntunga kipan a tawntung dongin nangmah in Pasian na hi hi.
Nangmah in, mi, leivui na suak kiksak a, “Mihing’ tate aw, ciahkik un!” na ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma muhna-ah kum tulkhat sung pen a bei ciangin zanni ahi a, zan-a khan’lawh khat sung tawh ahi zongin, kibang bek hi.
Nangmah in mite na phiatkhia hi; amaute in a ihmu tawh kibang uh a, zingsang-a a no kik lopa tawh kibang uh hi;
zingsangin palhin thaksuak kik a, nitak ciangin vulin keu uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na sinso-na in kote hong susia a, na hehluatna in kote hong laugawp sak hi.
Nangmah in kote’ mawhnate na mai-ah na koih a, ka khialh simnate uh na maitang ah na koih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hun khempeuh uh na hehna-in bei a, ka kumte uh husan’ khat bangin a bei hi.
Kote nuntak in kum sawmsagih sung hi a, cidam le-ung sawmgiat bang hi thei hi; ahih hangin tua hun sung in gimna leh haksatna hi a, tuate bei pakin, kote ka maimang uh hi.
Nang hong kizahtakna zah dingin kua in na sinso-na’ vangliatna thei a, na hehna’ husiatna thei ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin pilna lungsim ka ngah theih nadingun ka nuntak uh a tom lam ka theih nadingun hong hilh in.
Topa aw, hong kihei kik in! Bang tan sauvei ding ahi hiam? Na nasemte hong hehpih in!
Ka nuntak tawntung uh lungdamin ka kipak theih nadingun zingsangin na itna kip tawh kote hong lungkimsak in.
Kote nong gimsak ni zah leh siatna ka thuak uh kum zah mah, kote hong kipaaksak in.
Na nasemte tungah na nasepna leh, amau tate tungah na minthan’na vang hong kilangsak in.
Kote’ Topa Pasian’ maipha, komau tungah hong om sak in la, kote’ nasepna khempeuh hong tangtung sak in, hi hi, ka nasepna khempeuh uh-ah hong mavang sak in.
